g.title: Skill procedures (MOD-012)
Published procedure sources
Establish or revise the project purpose, intended outcomes, and product direction.
Establish or revise the project's governing engineering principles.
Build or refresh an observed repository orientation map with source and uncertainty boundaries.
Compare materially distinct directions for an unsettled engineering problem.
Resolve a bounded factual uncertainty with attributable evidence and an explicit conclusion.
Write a bounded engineering direction proposal and its feasibility basis.
Create or revise a living Design that reconciles behavior, architecture, decisions, and acceptance intent.
Allocate implementation work, dependencies, milestones, and verification from settled design.
Implement an approved milestone or explicitly bounded change with concrete proof for independent review.
Diagnose or correct a bounded defect against its governing behavior and reproducible evidence.
Review or revise repository automation for coverage, execution, permissions, and maintenance needs.
Review a proposed direction and feasibility basis before dependent design.
Review the affected Designs and interactions against approved direction.
Review implementation sequencing and verification allocation before implementation.
Review delivered implementation and proof against the approved design and delivery basis.
Select and coordinate the applicable engineering activity, correction owner, and authorized continuation.
Assess requested verification scope, current evidence, and engineering coherence, recording successful closeout only when justified.
Prepare or perform an explicitly authorized pull-request handoff from the current verified subject.
Capture supported reusable lessons and route derivative work to its accountable owner.
